Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Shawn Kemp?

Shawn Kemp is 56 years old.

Where was Shawn Kemp born?

Shawn Kemp was born in Elkhart, Indiana.

When was Shawn Kemp born?

Shawn Kemp was born on November 26, 1969.

How tall is Shawn Kemp?

Shawn Kemp is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Shawn Kemp weigh when playing?

Shawn Kemp weighed 230 lbs (104 kg) when playing.

Is Shawn Kemp in the Hall of Fame?

Shawn Kemp is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Shawn Kemp drafted?

Shawn Kemp was drafted by Seattle SuperSonics, 1st round (17th pick, 17th overall), 1989 NBA Draft.

What position did Shawn Kemp play?

Power Forward and Center.

When did Shawn Kemp retire?

Shawn Kemp last played in 2003.

What is Shawn Kemp's net worth?

Shawn Kemp made at least $91,572,963 playing professional basketball.

How much did Shawn Kemp make?

Shawn Kemp made $14,941,935 in 2004.

What did Shawn Kemp average?

Shawn Kemp averaged 14.6 points, 8.4 rebounds, and 1.6 assists per game.

How many rings does Shawn Kemp have?

Shawn Kemp won 0 championships.

What schools did Shawn Kemp attend?

Shawn Kemp attended Concord in Elkhart, Indiana, Kentucky - attended but did not play and Trinity Valley CC - attended but did not play.

What are Shawn Kemp's nicknames?

Reign Man is a nickname for Shawn Kemp.
